name: He's Just Away
source:
Your beloved husband, Seto, is dead.

But you refuse to believe it. Claiming he's just away. 

To alleviate your loneliness, you create an android replica of your beloved using your employer's highly classified AI chip, the "Heaven Project."

You intend for the android to be temporary. But he wants to make his stay permanent. 

[From [url=https://helloyinny.itch.io/hes-just-away]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你深爱的丈夫濑户去世了。

但你拒绝相信。声称他刚刚离开。

为了缓解你的孤独感，你使用雇主的高度机密人工智能芯片“天堂计划”创建了你所爱之人的机器人复制品。

你打算让Android成为临时的。但他想永久留下来。

[来自[url=https://helloyinny.itch.io/hes-just-away]itch.io[/url]]
